asp.title: ASP: learn languages with your own voice
paragraphs: A language-learning app I built for Kurdish speakers. Learners practise German and English by speaking, with every lesson explained in Badini Kurdish, so they can study without a teacher. More languages are coming soon. It grew out of my own German study and my A1.1 self-study course book.
ASP is live on the web and works on any phone: open it and add it to the home screen like an app. I launched it on TikTok in November 2026.
